name: medication-ai
description: Medication agent — turns a prescription into a finished course.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @medication-ai/server" "npm run dev -w @medication-ai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @medication-ai/server && npm run build -w @medication-ai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @medication-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @medication-ai/server && npm run typecheck -w @medication-ai/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @medication-ai/shared && npm run test -w @medication-ai/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
